chunks: Abdul-Wahid ibn Muhammad ibn Abdous al-Attar in Nishapur, year 352, told us: Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Qutayba, from Hamdan ibn Sulayman al-Naisabouri, told us: I asked Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn Musa al-Rida (peace be upon him)
about the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He:
"So, the one whom Allah wants to guide, He expands his chest to Islam"

He said: The one whom Allah wants to guide with his faith in this world to His Garden and the House of His Generosity in the Hereafter, He will expand his chest to submission to Allah, trust in Him and tranquility towards what He has promised of His reward until he is assured of Him. Moreover, the one whom He wants to lead astray from His Garden and House of Generosity in the Hereafter due to his disbelief and disobedience to Him in this world, He will make his chest tight, aggravated, until he doubts in his disbelief and his heart is distressed from his belief until he becomes as if he is elevating in the sky. Similarly, Allah makes impurity for those who do not believe.

key_terms.يَجْعَلْ صَدْرَهُ ضَيِّقًا حَرَجًا: He makes his chest tight and constrained (metaphor for agitation and distress)
key_terms.يَشْرَحْ صَدْرَهُ: He expands his chest (metaphor for openness and tranquility)

ai.seo_question: What does it mean for Allah to expand or narrow a person's chest according to Imam al-Rida?
ai.summary: In this narration from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Ma'ani al-Akhbar*, Imam al-Rida (AS) interprets the 'expansion of the chest' as a divine bestowal of inner tranquility and certainty in faith, while 'narrowing' signifies the spiritual constriction and doubt resulting from persistent disobedience. This exegesis highlights the psychological and spiritual dimensions of divine guidance, linking internal state directly to ultimate destiny. The concept resonates with the broader Quranic theme of how belief or disbelief affects the human soul's receptivity to truth.

en.basel-kadem: 2.	We were told by Abdul-Wahid bin Muhammed bin ‘Abdous al-‘Attar, in Nishapur, year 352, that he said: We were told by Ali bin Muhammed bin Qutayba, from Hamdan bin Sulayman al-Naisabouri, that he said: I asked Abu’l-Hasan, Ali bin Musa al-Rida, peace be upon him,
about the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He:
«So, the one whom Allah wants to guide, He expands his chest to Islam» [6:125].

He said: The one whom Allah wants to guide with his faith in this world to His Garden and the House of His Generosity in the Hereafter, He will expand his chest to submission to Allah, trust in Him and tranquility towards what He has promised of His reward until he is assured of Him. Moreover, the one whom He wants to lead astray from His Garden and House of Generosity in the Hereafter due to his disbelief and disobedience to Him in this world, He will make his chest tight, aggravated, until he doubts in his disbelief and his heart is distressed from his belief until he becomes as if he is elevating in the sky. Similarly, Allah makes impurity for those who do not believe.
